stories.title: Penge wins four-man play-off to claim first PGA Tour title and earn 2027 card
stories.summary: England's Marco Penge birdied the first extra hole in a four-man play-off to win the RSM Classic in Georgia and secure his PGA Tour card for 2027. Penge's five-under 65 in a delayed final round at the Sea Island Resort's Seaside Course had left him tied at 16 under overall, with American duo Max Greyserman and Michael Thorbjornsen, and China's Li Haotong.

stories.title: 49ers cut ties with Brandon Aiyuk after WR’s two-year stretch without playing a game
stories.summary: The San Francisco 49ers have cut ties with disgruntled wide receiver Brandon Aiyuk, freeing the former second-team All-Pro to join another team. A person familiar with the move said Aiyuk will be placed on waivers Monday. The person spoke on condition of anonymity because the team hadn’t announced the transaction.

stories.summary: Former India captain Sourav Ganguly has questioned India's decision to leave out specialist spinners Kuldeep Yadav and Manav Suthar from the playing XI for the first Test against New Zealand in Wellington. His comments came after India were held to a draw by New Zealand in the first Test at the Basin Reserve in Wellington.

stories.title: Intense and exhausting contests in store: Anand
stories.summary: The Salesforce FIDE World championship between D. Gukesh and Javokhir Sindarov will kick off in Geneva on Tuesday. stories.title: Raghuvanshi’s show guides Mumbai to commanding win over Chhattisgarh in the Syed Mushtaq Ali T20 cricket tournament
stories.summary: On his Indian Premier League (IPL) home ground, Angkrish Raghuvanshi scored a career-best 63-ball 84 not out as Mumbai cruised to a commanding nine-wicket win over Chhattisgarh in an Elite Group-D match of the Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy T20 tournament at the Eden Gardens here on Sunday. Chhattisgarh, asked to bat, scored 159, which the star-studded Mumbai side achieved with seven balls to spare.

stories.title: Shubman Gill explains why 'very good friend' Mohammed Siraj was dropped for New Zealand Test
stories.summary: India Test captain Shubman Gill defended the decision to leave Mohammed Siraj out of the playing XI after the first Test against New Zealand ended in a draw on Monday. Despite opting for a four-man pace attack, India had no place for Siraj, instead fielding Jasprit Bumrah, Akash Deep, Anshul Kamboj and Prasidh Krishna.

stories.title: Key questions as Rangers host Aberdeen & Dundee visit Hibs
stories.summary: One between two sides looking to recover from embarrassing home defeats, another a match-up between two teams looking to build on decent away victories. All four looking to make their game in hand count in Tuesday's Scottish Premiership double-header. So what's to look out for as second-top Rangers host Aberdeen and second-bottom Hibernian entertain Dundee?

stories.title: Indore Sports Roundup: Triple Tons Power Cricket Rout, Golf Duo Triumph, Young Champions Shine, Wrestling Showdown Awaits
stories.summary: Indore (Madhya Pradesh): Indore will host the 48th Inter-regional State-level Wrestling Competition of the Madhya Pradesh State Electricity Board at Malharashram School Wrestling Arena on December 8. Around 60 wrestlers and athletes from nearly 10 teams are expected to compete in the one-day championship.

stories.title: Daryl Mitchell, Phillips defy India as Wellington Test ends in a draw
stories.summary: India picked up five wickets in New Zealand's second innings but ran out of time as Daryl Mitchell and Glenn Philips' stubborn resistance denied them a win at the Basin Reserve. With the pitch offering little assistance, Mitchell and Phillips dug in to secure a draw. The second Test of the two-match series will be played in Christchurch from Friday.

stories.title: Alex Ovechkin Gives Children Battling Cancer a Special Day at the Capitals' Training Facility
stories.summary: During his final NHL season, Alex Ovechkin created a memorable experience for children affected by cancer at the Washington Capitals’ training facility. The young fans got an opportunity to step onto the ice, take shots from his famous scoring spot, and spend an unforgettable afternoon with the hockey legend.

stories.title: Miley Cyrus marries Maxx Morando in California ceremony
stories.summary: Miley Cyrus has married her partner of four years Maxx Morando during a ceremony in Palm Springs, California. Photos of the wedding on Saturday show the ceremony took place by a swimming pool with the pair standing under an arch covered in white flowers. The singer's mother, Tish Cyrus, and sister, Noah Cyrus, were in attendance, Entertainment Tonight reported.

stories.title: How J&K recruitment Board’s cheating case put a spotlight on Lok Bhavan, CM office powers? | Explained
stories.summary: The J&K Service Selection Board (JKSSB), the Union Territory’s main recruiting agency, on November 15 came under the scanner of the J&K Police over the alleged attempts to use unfair means by several aspirants to pass the examination in the Jammu region. 62 lakh aspirants had applied. The J&K Police has arrested 20 accused so far.

stories.title: Explainer-Mexico nabs yet another top drug lord, but history of ‘Kingpin Strategy’ mixed
stories.summary: Chapo Isidro was considered one of the leaders of the Beltrán Leyva Organization, a former ally of the powerful Sinaloa Cartel that later became one of its top rivals. His capture is the latest in a string of arrests of high-profile suspected drug traffickers as Mexico — under intense pressure from US President Donald Trump — has decisively returned to the so-called Kingpin Strategy.

stories.title: 8th Pay Commission: Civilian defence staff seek 6% annual increment, OPS and 50% DA merger— 13 key demands explained
stories.summary: The Bharatiya Pratiraksha Mazdoor Sangh (BPMS), an all-India federation of civilian defence employees recognised by the Ministry of Defence, has submitted a fresh list of around 73 demands to the 8th Central Pay Commission (CPC), seeking substantial improvements in salaries, pensions and service benefits for central government employees, particularly defence civilian personnel.

stories.title: Who is Sugandha Hiremath? Meet businesswoman at centre of Kalyani family’s ₹1 lakh crore ancestral wealth dispute
stories.summary: Sugandha Hiremath, sister of Bharat Forge chairman Baba Kalyani, is at the centre of a high-profile inheritance dispute involving the Kalyani family’s ancestral wealth , estimated at more than ₹ 1 lakh crore. The legal battle, which has dragged on across judicial forums, involves claims over family assets, properties and stakes in companies linked to the Pune-based industrial family.

stories.title: From kala pani to Rikers, history of island prisons and the waters used to lock people in | HT Explainers
stories.summary: In Alexandre Dumas's The Count of Monte Cristo, the young sailor Edmond Dantès works out where the gendarmes are rowing him only as the boat nears the Château d'If, a fortress on a rock off Marseille. He protests that it holds only political prisoners, and asks whether there are any magistrates or judges there.

stories.title: Everyday Explained: Why do wooden doors swell during monsoons and become difficult to shut?
stories.summary: From humidity to moisture absorption, an expert explains why wooden doors swell during monsoons and become difficult to shut. A door that closes effortlessly one day may suddenly start getting stuck in its frame when the rains arrive. This common monsoon inconvenience is not necessarily a sign of poor carpentry or damaged hinges.

stories.title: Can you fix a scratched CD? Here are your options
stories.summary: ArtCreationsDesignPhoto/Shutterstock : Preferred Source Google Discover Just like vinyl records before them, CDs are back . As strange as it may seem if you grew up with them, CDs have become a nostalgic icon of the joys of physical media — but they're also a reminder of why we all went digital in the first place.

stories.title: Who is Artemis Patrick? Meet Sephora CEO as she reveals why she once refused to work at the beauty company
stories.summary: Sephora CEO Artemis Patrick has revealed that she once rejected a job offer from the beauty retailer because she was unwilling to follow its strict dress code. The incident dates back to 1998, when Sephora was a small perfumery recently acquired by luxury group LVMH. At the time, the company required its employees to wear outfits in only three colours: black, white or grey.

stories.title: Manchester's Co-op Live evacuated after 'unknown substance' let off in crowd at concert by US rapper Don Toliver
stories.summary: It happened towards the end of US rapper Don Toliver's show at the Co-op Live arena at about 22:00 GMT on Sunday, with fans describing a "horrible smell" and people "screaming" and "coughing up blood". One person was taken to hospital while more than 80 people were assessed for "eye and respiratory symptoms", the North West Ambulance Service said.

stories.title: What important features should you look for in a home security camera?
stories.summary: HighAZ/Shutterstock : Preferred Source Google Discover When you're shopping for the best home gadgets , a lot of decisions tend to be based purely on budget or personal preferences. No one needs an RGB lamp, for example, and an accessory that works with Google Home will usually function just as well paired with Amazon Alexa or Apple Home.

stories.title: What happened to Jaylen Harrell? Police reveal alleged Uber driver assault before Titans star’s crash
stories.summary: Tennessee Titans defensive end Jaylen Harrell is facing questions after a serious car accident in Tampa, Florida, left him hospitalized with major injuries. According to the Tampa Police Department, the 24-year-old allegedly assaulted his Uber driver while riding in the back seat on Friday morning, November 20. Police say the driver lost control after the reported incident, hitting another vehicle before crashing into a utility pole.

stories.title: What next after COP31: Countries return to table at UN's Bonn talks in June 2027 | HT Explainers
stories.summary: The United Nations’ mid-year climate meetings in Bonn in June 2027 are the first formal chance for governments to return to the disputes over fossil fuels and money for poorer countries that left COP31 without a deal, five months before the next summit in Ethiopia.

stories.title: Is air pollution putting India’s frontline workers at risk? | In Focus Podcast
stories.summary: With the onset of winter, air pollution levels in Indian cities have touched alarming highs once again. While discussions around air pollution often centre on soaring AQI levels, smog and measures to curb vehicular emissions, what tends to get overlooked is its disproportionate impact on the most vulnerable groups, particularly those whose jobs expose them to polluted air for prolonged periods.

stories.title: Who is Sai Pallavi’s family? Meet her parents and younger sister
stories.summary: M: Operation Mole’. While the actress has made a name for herself in South Indian and Hindi cinema, she comes from a family with no film background. Sai Pallavi’s father, Senthamarai Kannan, is a retired Central Excise officer and a former football player. According to a fan-driven website, he was an accomplished footballer before joining the civil service.

stories.title: Can Congress Turn Anti-AAP Sentiment Into A Comeback in Punjab?
stories.summary: On November 4, Rahul Gandhi returned to Punjab, a State where the Congress party has historically known how to sway voters and win elections. Launching the campaign for the Punjab Assembly elections in Sangrur, an Aam Aadmi Party (AAP) stronghold, Rahul attacked the AAP’s record in government and argued that Punjab needed a government that worked for the State rather than being “run from Delhi”.

stories.title: GTA 6 Mandy sink mystery explained: Did Jason find a human finger inside her drain?
stories.summary: A routine repair job takes a disturbing turn in GTA 6 when Jason discovers something unusual while trying to clear Mandy’s blocked sink. What first looks like an ordinary household problem may point towards a much darker side of the mysterious character. Players have begun examining the scene closely, and one detail has sparked a chilling theory: the object lodged inside the pipe could be a human finger.

stories.title: Is your breathing at risk? A pulmonologist shares signs that your COPD might be in a flare-up
stories.summary: Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD) is a progressive lung condition that makes breathing difficult due to restricted airflow in the lungs. It includes conditions such as chronic bronchitis and emphysema. One of the major challenges for people living with COPD is the occurrence of flare-ups, also known as exacerbations.

stories.title: Who is taking part in France's recent street protests?
stories.summary: Student demonstrators demanding better conditions have been joined by yellow vest activists and others, angry about the rising cost of living. Images of young, masked protesters dressed in black, clashing with police and smashing up shop windows, have made headlines around the world. President Macron has blamed the unrest on the radical left.

stories.title: How did the COP31 climate agreement fall apart – and what happens now?
stories.summary: Two days after the COP31 global climate summit was supposed to finish, the talks in Antalya, Turkey, have come to an end – but not as we might have hoped. Agreement simply could not be reached. The sticking point was the omission of fossil fuels in draft texts.

stories.title: Karthigai Deepam row explained: What is Deepathoon dispute, and why has Tamil Nadu challenged Supreme Court order?
stories.summary: The Tamil Nadu government, led by Chief Minister Vijay, sought a review of the Supreme Court's one-time permission to light the traditional Karthigai Deepam lamp at Deepathoon, a disputed stone lamp pillar on Thiruparankundram Hill in Madurai, on November 24. The Commissioner of Tamil Nadu's Hindu Religious and Charitable Endowments Department moved the Supreme Court seeking a review of the court's recent order.

stories.title: What do other planets smell like? The answer hides in their chemistry
stories.summary: Humanity has long looked up and yearned to know more about the glowing dots in the night sky. Over the past century, advances in technology have allowed us to glean amazingly good insights into both distant stars and our closest cosmic neighbors.

stories.title: Winter wedding scents: Oud and woody notes for December celebrations, explained by a perfumer
stories.summary: Indian weddings have always been special and a close to heart celebration. Marigold garlands, fairtail at the mandap, the smoke of the havan and the spices of the wedding kitchen all leave an impression that lives with us long after the photographs. The biggest wedding celebration season is on the way.

stories.title: The AQI paradox: Why the official count may be downplaying the pollution problem | HT Explainers
stories.summary: On November 10, two days after Diwali, the Central Pollution Control Board (CPCB) cautioned people against trusting apps that "derive AQI from instantaneous hourly readings", because the national air quality index (AQI), it said, reflects "prolonged exposure, rather than a momentary reading". It was an odd caution to come from the board.

stories.title: Who has won the most women's singles titles at the Syed Modi International?
stories.summary: V. Sindhu and Saina Nehwal have been the torchbearers of Indian badminton in women’s singles. Lucknow will host the 15th edition of the Syed Modi India International from November 24 to 29. Introduced as a BWF Grand Prix event in 2009, the tournament was upgraded to the World Tour Super 300 category in 2018.

stories.title: From entire towers to entire floors, Mumbai investors drive big-ticket property deals | Real Estate News
stories.summary: An emerging trend in Mumbai’s luxury property market is seeing ultra-high-net-worth individuals (UHNIs) move beyond buying individual apartments or office units to acquiring entire residential towers and commercial floors. While one buyer may be looking for the privacy and exclusivity of a private mansion, another may see an entire office floor as a long-term investment, a future workplace or a source of rental income.

stories.title: Charlie Puth to make India debut with Ellie Goulding at Mumbai music festival in February 2027
stories.summary: American singer Charlie Puth is set to make his India debut alongside British singer Ellie Goulding at the inaugural Johnnie & Co. Festival in Mumbai on February 13, 2027. The one-day event will be held at the Mahalaxmi Racecourse and is expected to attract more than 35,000 attendees.

stories.title: Sonu Nigam turns Raipur-Mumbai flight into mini concert after passengers sing his hit songs | See video
stories.summary: Singer Sonu Nigam had an unexpected musical evening while travelling from Raipur to Mumbai, after fellow passengers turned his routine flight into a singalong featuring some of his most popular songs. stories.title: Mumbai International Crime Festival brings together actors, authors, filmmakers, investigators and survivors to explore crime through literature and cinema
stories.summary: ound for crime literature, cinema and real-life experiences as the inaugural Mumbai International Crime Festival brought together storytellers, survivors, investigators, actors, writers and filmmakers for two days of discussions on crime, criminals and their portrayal on screen.

stories.title: Central Bank Of India Holds Nationwide MSME Credit Outreach, Mumbai Event Highlights Seven Lending Schemes
